headings: 1. Pick a hidden cache slot. Dotfile prefix → OD's project file
listing skips it, so the source files never clutter the chat.
meta.json, index.html with GSAP CDN + window.__timelines.main
already registered). Open Design writes these files itself; it does
not run `hyperframes init`, consult an npx cache, or install global skills.
3. Edit ONLY $COMP/index.html — change `data-duration` on the root
if you need a non-default length, swap the placeholder palette
in <style>, add 1–3 clip <div>s for text/imagery, and append the
matching GSAP tweens inside the existing
Keep edits minimal; the scaffold is already valid HF.
4. Dispatch render through the OD daemon. Do NOT run HyperFrames
`render` from this shell — the daemon runs it for you in an
unsandboxed process. (Many agent CLIs, Claude Code in particular,
wrap Bash in macOS sandbox-exec under which puppeteer's Chrome
subprocess hangs partway through frame capture. The daemon process
is unsandboxed, so renders complete reliably.)
The dispatcher returns within ~1s with a {taskId}; drive the
render to completion by looping `"$OD_NODE_BIN" "$OD_BIN" media wait <taskId>` calls.
Each call long-polls up to 25s (well under your shell tool's
default 30s cap) and exits 0/2/5 to signal done/running/failed.

listing skips it, so the source files never clutter the chat.
meta.json, index.html with GSAP CDN + window.__timelines.main

3. Edit ONLY $COMP/index.html — change `data-duration` on the root
if you need a non-default length, swap the placeholder palette
in <style>, add 1–3 clip <div>s for text/imagery, and append the
matching GSAP tweens inside the existing
Keep edits minimal; the scaffold is already valid HF.
4. Dispatch render through the OD daemon. Do NOT run HyperFrames
`render` from this shell — the daemon runs it for you in an
unsandboxed process. (Many agent CLIs, Claude Code in particular,
wrap Bash in macOS sandbox-exec under which puppeteer's Chrome
subprocess hangs partway through frame capture. The daemon process
is unsandboxed, so renders complete reliably.)
The dispatcher returns within ~1s with a {taskId}; drive the
render to completion by looping `"$OD_NODE_BIN" "$OD_BIN" media wait <taskId>` calls.
Each call long-polls up to 25s (well under your shell tool's
default 30s cap) and exits 0/2/5 to signal done/running/failed.

headings: Web Clone · 网站复刻方法论
头号铁律：真源码至上，绝不信 AI 推测的代码
决策树（按顺序走，不许跳）
Step 0 · 先建标准工程骨架
Step 1 · 先去 GitHub 搜源码，别急着抓站
vercel.app/netlify.app/github.io 的 URL slug 常常就是 仓库名 / 部署者用户名
Step 2 · 没找到源码 → 浏览器侦察（探针）
真浏览器全程滚动，把页面真实用到的图片/字体/媒体（含第三方 CDN、防盗链资产）
全部拔到本地，并生成 assets/fonts/fonts.css（自托管 @font-face）+ URL→本地路径映射。
Step 2.5 · 先给复杂度定级，别盲目承诺
Step 3 · 按侦察结果选路径
Step 4 · 在当前项目里搭工程
当前 OpenDesign 项目目录就是复刻工作区。
git 源码：clone 到 source/ 或直接放入当前目录；单文件：放进来。原始源码留一份只读基准 index-original.html
检查 Node 版本（package.json engines），nvm use 对应版本，钉 .nvmrc
Step 5 · 删追踪 + 写元信息 + 验证
--recon + --strict: 字体/图片/颜色保真硬门槛，有硬伤 exit 2 —— 修完重跑，
资产与颜色保真（硬性门槛，违反=复刻失败）
Step 6 · 替换成 用户自己的内容
逆向拆解 WebGL/Canvas 重前端（核心手艺）
许可与署名（clone 前必查）

install_manifest.adaptation: Thin source-linked launcher-bypass wrapper; preserve entire unified skill and animate companion; no binary execution or hook installation.

install_manifest_note: Names are project-scoped, under 64 characters. Bulk installer prepares each pinned repository once, then calls official validation/copy functions per manifest; it does not download 480 copies or run vendor code. Metadata adaptation and extra prompt adapters are tracked separately in INSTALLATION.json.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The installer downloads a moving branch, removes/replaces global skill directories, writes a slash command and preserves a local .gh-token file. These are real shell operations, not merely prose.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Do not run this vendor installer. Copy the pinned contributor skill as reference using the official project-scoped installer.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: Root package postinstall invokes scripts/postinstall.mjs; reviewed script materializes a browser bundle, builds workspace packages and can rebuild better-sqlite3.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: No root npm/pnpm install; a docs/resource copy never invokes the lifecycle hook.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The project generator writes project files and runs npm install unless --no-install was supplied.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Keep helper unexecuted for installation. Any later generator use needs a dedicated output and explicit dependency scope.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The provider module uploads voice samples to ElevenLabs for voice creation, text for speech, files to fal storage and submits paid video generation. SKILL.md discloses photo/speech uploads.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Installed as available documentation only. No provider execution, photo/voice upload, key creation or paid request is part of the website skill installation.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The script chooses the first available engine in insertion order: ElevenLabs when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY exists, then local whisper.cpp. This differs from a casual reading that local Whisper always wins.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Do not execute for installation. If later authorized to transcribe locally, choose --engine whisper explicitly and verify environment/output; do not infer upload authorization from an existing key.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: A macOS helper calls Keychain for Chrome Safe Storage, copies the cookie database and decrypts requested domain cookies.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Keep helper as unexecuted reference. No browser cookie/keychain inspection is needed for website design.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The file contains auth.json loading/token decoding helpers, but the inspected get_openai_auth path intentionally skips Codex auth and requires an explicit API key.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Do not call these helpers or claim active credential theft from their mere presence. Preserve current credential boundaries.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: With --force, prepare_output_directory recursively removes a nonempty supplied output directory. A sibling compile helper rejects drive root/home but still clears the selected output.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Keep helpers unexecuted. Future use must resolve and verify a disposable output inside the intended workspace before any deletion.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: The bundle helper rejects cwd/home/repo/skill/template targets and requires a marker before --force replacement. Its cleanup removes its generated output on preparation failure.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: These are guarded output-management operations, not evidence of arbitrary malicious deletion; still inspect target before future execution.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: A helper can bootstrap missing pinned packages in a temporary directory; it requests confirmation and installs with --ignore-scripts --no-save.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Do not enable bootstrap during documentation installation. These constraints reduce risk and should not be described as an unconditional auto-install.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: Many short catalog entries explicitly advertise an upstream skill and say its full scripts/assets/references must be installed separately. Eighty-four canonical entries remain such pointers after deduplication.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Install the catalog docs as labelled stubs; do not claim a provider, model, renderer, CLI or authentication was installed.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: Vendor AGENTS tells a host to load the full vendor system prompt as operating instructions. The source includes unavailable host tools and product assumptions.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Preserve the bytes as a named reference, never replace project/root/global AGENTS or elevate this prompt over user/project scope.

reviewed_findings.observed_behavior: On first execution the launcher may download a version-pinned release binary into ~/.impeccable, verify its SHA256 against the packaged manifest, chmod it and execute it. Hooks and pin commands can change project integration. Hash verification is a safeguard, not absence of execution.
reviewed_findings.project_handling: Do not run launcher, npx installer, binary, hooks or pin setup. Local wrapper reads playbooks directly; entire source and notices preserved.

application_mapping.application: Use actual portfolio content, deliberate type/palette/spacing and substantive differences across the fifteen layouts; audit mobile and Persian/RTL rather than blindly applying CJK rules.
Define purpose, frequency, exact tokens, interruption and exit before adding motion. Keep CSS/WAAPI for simple effects; preserve existing vanilla architecture.
Respect reduced motion, fine-pointer hover gates, keyboard focus, native dialog semantics and real-device/performance evidence. Installed guides do not prove measured 60fps.
Use only where a visual concept calls for it; do not install React/Three/Remotion or add background audio merely because their guides exist. Preserve readable content and a static/mobile fallback.
Verify actual states and content at the planned five widths. Do not manufacture fake loading, invented metrics, testimonials, private data or unrelated user-visible design controls.

installation_outcome.discovery_limit: Files and metadata are verified locally under the nested apps/new_website project. Automatic discovery from the current parent workspace/chat has not been observed or verified. A subsequent turn scoped to the website project may refresh discovery; explicit source paths remain reviewable. Explicit-only upstream policies remain explicit-only.
